# 74198 - 8-bit shift register

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74198.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74198.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 38 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74198 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74198.png) | ![74198 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74198.png) | ![74198 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74198.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,6,8,10,14,16,18,20 | QA..QH = Q[0..7] | Register bits. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR' low: QA..QH = L at once
- CLOCK low (no edge): hold
- S1=H, S0=H: parallel load QA..QH = A..H at the clock edge
- S1=L, S0=H: shift right (QA toward QH): QA = SR SER, QB = QAn, ..., QH = QGn
- S1=H, S0=L: shift left (QH toward QA): QH = SL SER, QG = QHn, ..., QA = QBn
- S1=L, S0=L: clock inhibited, hold
- Change the mode inputs only while CLOCK is high

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| /CLEAR | QA..QH | PHL | 23 | 35 |
| CLOCK | QA..QH | PHL | 20 | 30 |
| CLOCK | QA..QH | PLH | 17 | 26 |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| maxClockFrequency | CLOCK |  |  | 25 | 35 |
| pulseWidth | CLOCK or CLEAR' |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | S0, S1 | CLOCK | 30 |  |  |
| setup | data | CLOCK | 20 |  |  |
| hold | any input | CLOCK | 0 |  |  |

## Not known

- No minimum propagation delays printed.
- Clear-to-output low-to-high is not applicable; no other paths listed.

## Notes

Bidirectional; four modes: load, shift right, shift left, inhibit.
